plugin_desc: Zyxel switch SNMP collection (enterprise 890). For NebulaFlex/XGS1930/XS1930 (sysObjectID prefix 1.3.6.1.4.1.890.1.15) it collects ES-COMMON CPU and memory utilization (sysMgmtCPUUsage / sysMgmtMemUsage, direct 0-100 percent) as top-level scalar GETs. Older GS lines keep the 890.1.5.8.20 CPU scalar and temperature table as fallback. Interface traffic comes from the built-in IF-MIB table. This plugin does not collect GS1900 HW-MONITOR temperature; fan is raw RPM (not a state) and power-supply state is N/A.
name: Switch

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports the CPU utilization of the Zyxel device control plane as a 0-100 percentage. On NebulaFlex/XGS1930/XS1930 (sysObjectID prefix 1.3.6.1.4.1.890.1.15) it is read from ES-COMMON sysMgmtCPUUsage; older GS devices fall back to the 890.1.5.8.20 CPU scalar. Sustained high CPU usage can indicate control-plane overload, routing instability, or attack traffic, and may lead to slow management response or packet processing delays.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports overall memory utilization of the Zyxel device as a direct 0-100 percentage (ES-COMMON sysMgmtMemUsage) on NebulaFlex/XGS1930/XS1930 (sysObjectID prefix 1.3.6.1.4.1.890.1.15). High memory usage may indicate memory leaks, oversized MAC/ARP tables, or insufficient capacity, and can cause instability or failed allocations.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: This metric reports the temperature reading of each Zyxel hardware sensor (ZYXEL private MIB temperature table), in degrees Celsius. Abnormally high temperatures may indicate fan failure, blocked airflow, or excessive ambient heat, and can trigger thermal protection or hardware damage if left unaddressed.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
